description: The chart illustrates task counts across language-family categories, shown as a grouped vertical bar chart with multiple colored bars per category to represent different series (as indicated by a legend with at least a light-green entry). The category axis is horizontal and lists language-family labels in a left-to-right order that includes “Romance,” “IE-Slavic,” “IE-other,” “Isolate,” “Semitic,” and “Uralic” (additional categories may be present but are partially cropped), with labels angled to fit; the value axis is vertical, labeled “task count,” and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks at approximately 20, 30, and 40 (the plotted range extends to at least 40). For each category, three adjacent bars are visible in dark blue, light blue, and light green; for “Romance,” the dark-blue bar is around the high 20s, the light-blue bar is around the high teens, and the light-green bar is around 40; for “IE-Slavic,” the dark-blue bar reaches roughly 50, the light-blue bar is around 30, and the light-green bar is around the mid-40s; for “IE-other,” the dark-blue bar is around the high 20s, the light-blue bar is near the low 20s, and the light-green bar is around the low 30s; for “Isolate,” the bars are shorter, with dark blue around the low 30s and the light-blue and light-green bars near the mid-to-high 20s; for “Semitic,” the dark-blue bar is around the high 30s while the light-blue and light-green bars are near the low 30s; and for “Uralic,” the dark-blue bar is around the mid-40s, the light-blue bar is around the low 30s, and the light-green bar is around 40. The bars appear uniformly styled without special outlines or annotations, and there is no explicit indication in the visible portion that categories are sorted by value rather than presented in the shown label order.
